title: Pocket Kingdom: Own the World
notes: The game was built around online play on N-Gage Arena, which no longer exists and is greyed out here. Offline Play is what works: buy units and items in the Shop, form a party under Party > Form, then send it out from Map > Search to find items and bases.
Key 5 or OK selects and key 7 goes back. Either soft key opens the system menu with Resume, Volume, Save and Title.
To keep your progress, use Save in the system menu (going to Title also offers to save).

controls.source: Observed in the game's menus during Offline Play: the pad, OK, 5 (select), 7 (back) and both soft keys (system menu). No controls screen was found in the game; publisher and year are from general knowledge of the game.
notes: The standard layout suits this game: arrows move the cursor, Enter is OK, Q or W opens the system menu, and 5 and 7 on the digit row select and go back.
On a gamepad A or X selects, Y goes back, and LB, RB, Start or Back opens the system menu.

statusNote: Offline Play works: the title, a new game, the castle with its advisor's tutorial, the shop (bought an item and a unit), forming a party, the world map and an area search that brought back an item all ran, and saving from the system menu gives a Continue entry on the title. N-Gage Arena, the online game this was built around, is greyed out on the title menu.
